messages:
alex: Quick Q — what's our plan for the Accept-Model header deprecation? customers are asking whether the SDK will auto-pin or we flip the default.

sam: We have a canary in staging that tests unpinning the default, scheduled for next Wed. Not yet public.

mei: Do we have a clear fallback semantics doc? If Accept-Model is missing, does the server pick a pinned version, return an error, or default to latest?

alex: My leaning: require explicit header (412) for the public API. For PLG/tiny test accounts we could keep a legacy last-stable fallback for a short grace period. Need to decide.

tara: Infra opinion: silently switching defaults will create subtle client breakages. 412 with a helpful error is safer operationally.

jon: 412 sounds reasonable. We also need a migration window and a clear header format. Proposed header: Accept-Model: redwood/model-x@1.4 (no spaces). What's the 412 payload look like?

sam: Example 412 response we can use in docs:
```http
HTTP/1.1 412 Precondition Failed
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "accept_model_required",
  "message": "Add Accept-Model header, e.g. 'Accept-Model: redwood/model-x@1.4' or set an explicit pin in the Console. See https://redwood.ai/docs/accept-model"
}
```

infra-bot: rolling canary -> staging cluster-3 at 2026-03-10T15:00Z (id: rc-20260310-03)

mei: A question about variant fallback: do we allow a version-range or fallback list like `redwood/model-x@1.4|1.3`? Clients probably won't implement that.

sam: Keep the header single-version only. If customers need multi-variant handling, they should handle it client-side or use our routing policies. We'll add an SDK helper that accepts a list and handles retries.

tara: Action items: sam -> add 412 response shape + docs; mei -> SDK flag + helper for Accept-Model; alex -> customer comms draft; jon -> run smoke/integration tests against canary.

alex: @sam @mei @jon can we get PRs by EOD Mon so we can run a soft rollout?

sam: :thumbsup: will open PRs. Also adding a runtime metric `accept_model_missing` to Console and a dashboard tile.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary started on staging (canary-20260310-3)

jon: will run integration tests now and ping CS + support if we see any regressions.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone wants to quick-sync, I'll do a 10m call tomorrow morning. Otherwise we'll do async and track PRs on the pinning epic.
